game: LAC @ NYG | 2025-09-28 13:00 ET | NYG +6 | total 43.5 | outdoor, weather forecast not saved

script.base: Book expects a one-score LAC lead: NYG +6, total 43.5, implied LAC 24.8 / NYG 18.8, outdoor 13:00 ET, not a shootout. LAC leads by halftime or late and leans on Omarion Hampton (42 carries, 142 yards in weeks 1-3) to close; Justin Herbert does not need a track meet. NYG as a 6-point dog throws to stay in range through Malik Nabers (32 targets, 531 air yards) and Wan'Dale Robinson (22 targets, 223 yards). Cam Skattebo keeps a mixed role only because Tyrone Tracy Jr. is out; NYG is not the projected leader.
script.flip1: LAC gets up by two scores early, kills the clock with Hampton, and Herbert/WR yards stall. NYG abandons the run, Skattebo's rushing line dies, and Wilson's attempts plus Nabers, Wan'Dale and Skattebo targets spike.
script.flip2: Russell Wilson's legs (16 carries, 94 yards) and a competitive or NYG-led script keep it one score or flip the lead. LAC cannot sit on Hampton; Herbert attacks NYG's 39% blitz (LAC EPA/db 0.41 vs blitz vs 0.15 vs none), so Keenan Allen, Quentin Johnston and Ladd McConkey become the live path and Hampton's rush stalls.

injury_fallout: Source: official pre-game nflverse injury report in the pack. NYG RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. Out (shoulder) vacates 22 carries/68 rush yards and 13 targets/54 yards over 3 games. Next man is Cam Skattebo (23 carries/102 rush, 13 targets/87 rec); Devin Singletary (8/24 rush, rec yards 0, -4, 0) can vulture carries but has not been the passing-down back. NYG DE Chauncey Golston Out (ankle) and DT Rakeem Nunez-Roches Doubtful (foot) weaken the NYG front and help the LAC run if the LAC line holds. NYG K Graham Gano Out is irrelevant to these markets. LAC G Mekhi Becton Out (concussion) and C Bradley Bozeman Questionable (back) raise pressure and cut rush efficiency if Bozeman sits (more quick throws, worse Hampton/Najee efficiency). LAC TE Will Dissly Out (knee) is a small shift to Oronde Gadsden (7/46) and Tyler Conklin (4/50), neither on the available board. LAC WR Derius Davis Out (knee) is a gadget (2 carries, 5 yards), not in the target list. LAC S Elijah Molden Questionable (hamstring) is the only coverage name; if he sits, Nabers' deep shots (531 air yards) face a backup, but he is not ruled out. Inactives about 90 minutes before kick are not in the pack.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Tracy is out after 22 carries and 13 targets in three games, Skattebo already has the passing-down work (13 targets, 87 yards) and is trending up (rush+rec 9, 59, 121), and 59.5 is only his with-Tracy median, so the vacated role should clear a combo line whether NYG runs while close or throws as a dog.
edge_players.must_be_true: Tracy stays inactive, Skattebo takes the lead snap share rather than a 50/50 split with Singletary, and NYG has enough plays that a bump on a 59-yard median can clear 59.5.
edge_players.kills_it: Singletary vultures early-down carries and Skattebo's receiving stays at the 12- and 14-yard games; or NYG is blown out so early that even targets do not add up; or the real market, not in this pack, already moved well past 59.5.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and the over lost because NYG trailed by two scores, Singletary took the between-the-tackles work he already samples (8 carries, 24 yards), and Skattebo's receiving reverted to 12 and 14 instead of the 61-yard spike, finishing near the 9-yard rush+rec floor. LAC allowing 5.09 YPC did not matter if the carry count never rose. The 18.8 implied team total was the tell that NYG plays were scarce. A second miss path is that the real market had already moved and this median stand-in was never a bettable price. That counter-case is real, which is why this is a lean and a flag, not a sized bet. It is not stronger than the official Tracy-out role bump, so the leg is not cut.
slip_story: One story: NYG backfield consolidation after Tracy Out in a LAC-lead, NYG-throws game. rushrecyds over belongs to that story because it can cash if they run while close or throw while trailing. Do not pair it with a game under, with Hampton rush over (that needs LAC to lead and grind, and his OL is compromised), or with Nabers/Wan'Dale overs that need the spike games to repeat. Single leg, no TD, one market per player. No parlay built. No bet placed.
